title: Technical Officer
content_text: Bogan Shire Council Technical Officer, Nyngan NSW, permanent full time, Grade 6 $1,615.19 to $1,869.79 per week, applications close 4:30pm Thursday 22 October 2026. Works with the Director Infrastructure Services on technical, compliance and project support across roads, fleet, aerodrome, environmental compliance, quarry operations and grant funded projects. Requires Certificate IV in Civil Construction Design (or equivalent) with at least three years' experience in a civil, infrastructure or local government environment; Class C licence; White Card; Australian citizenship, permanent residency or a visa permitting ongoing employment in Australia. Apply with cover letter, resume and two referees; questions to People and Community (02) 6835 9000.
apply_instructions: Cover letter, resume and two referees via the council application (movetomore listing); questions to People and Community on (02) 6835 9000.
